_comment: Atlas Growth :: US residential home addition contractors, nationwide, warm states first (ICP-additions.md). Engine config for google-maps-scrape. Job-specific values live ONLY here. Qualification is LENIENT by operator decision 2026-10-11 ('lenient'): no review floor, no website rule; the universe is cut by primary-type and name denies here and the real Qualified/Review/Exclude verdict comes from the site-text gate (STEP 5e, classify-prompt.md). There is NO native 'home addition' Google category (references/google-maps-categories.md, 2026-10-07): the trade hides under Remodeler / General contractor / Construction company / home-builder types, so the keyword rows and the text gate carry the precision.

categories._r: STEP 2: native categories that carry this trade. 'Remodeler' and 'General contractor' are P1; the builder/construction types P2 (a design-build firm is often typed Custom home builder or Construction company). 'Kitchen remodeler' / 'Bathroom remodeler' / 'Sunroom contractor' / 'Garage builder' are not queried (siblings) but are KEPT by the allow rule when they ride in as tags, because many such firms also build additions — the text gate decides. Keyword rows (kw:addition, P3) are fuzzy-matched on names/descriptions and routed to classify when the allow rule drops them (SKILL STEP 5b keyword recovery).

scrape_tuning._r: Same settings as the pools and US generator runs (measured ~2.1-2.6 Maps calls per runsheet row). paginate:true pages each viewport via offset; max_pages 6 x limit 150 caps a dense metro; max_depth 1 = at most one quadrant split.

qualify_rules._r: 1. Must-drop PRIMARY types: single-trade and replacement contractors (roofing, siding, windows, gutters, flooring, painting, fence, paving, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest, cleaning), the suppliers and stores, the design-only and referral professions (architect, interior designer, engineer, home inspector), realty/property, and civic bodies. Primary-only on purpose: a remodeler carrying an incidental 'Flooring contractor' or 'Kitchen remodeler' tag must survive to the site-text gate. Substring-matched against the lowercased PRIMARY type, so every term is multi-word or unambiguous (IMPROVEMENTS: 'spa' ate 'Coworking space'); 'contractor', 'construction', 'builder', 'design' are never used bare.
qualify_rules.label: off_icp_type

qualify_rules._r: 2. Must-drop by NAME (always fires, primary or secondary type): big-box and lumber chains, civic bodies, apartments/HOAs. Every term is multi-word or a brand (substring trap). No trade words here: lenient means a 'Handyman & Remodeling' or 'Roofing & Construction' name reaches the text gate.
qualify_rules.label: name_deny

qualify_rules._r: 3. Positive allow on google_types-ANY (never primary). Keeps every row Google tagged with a remodeling / general-contracting / home-building / sunroom / garage type and lets the site-text gate separate addition builders from kitchen-bath-only, replacement, new-construction-only and commercial firms. Rows WITHOUT any such tag (e.g. the bare 'Contractor' type, 'Carpenter', 'Building firm') are dropped here as not_in_icp and come back two ways at $0: (a) keyword rows (icp_type kw:addition) go to classify per SKILL STEP 5b keyword recovery; (b) generic types whose NAME says addition/remodel/build are re-admitted by recover-generic-additions-config.json.
qualify_rules.label: not_in_icp

_no_review_floor: Operator 2026-10-11: LENIENT. No review_count floor. Re-add {review_count >= N} here if the Review bucket is too large to work.
_no_website_rule: Deliberately NO {website, exists} rule: collapse-domains.js routes no-website and shared-host rows to the STEP 5d recovery track AFTER the denies have run.

brand_families._r: Keep every branch, flag the brand (same directive as the sibling verticals). Matched as lowercase substrings of '<name> <root_domain>', so every term is distinctive. Replacement and handyman franchises are listed so a branch is flagged, not dropped by name; the site-text gate excludes them on what they sell.

owner_query._r: DataForSEO backend (engine, 2026-10-11). serp_mode standard = the batch API ($0.0018 per query measured vs $0.006 live). --max-cost is required on every run; probe first ($1 / 100 Qualified leads), then set the real cap. Credentials are NOT on this container (2026-10-11): place DATAFORSEO_LOGIN + DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD in skills/google-maps-scrape/.env before STEP 6.
